name: Following feed shows friendly guidance when you follow no one
description: A brand-new user opens the social feed's Following tab without following anyone yet. Instead of a blank list or an endless spinner, a card explains they're not following anyone and points them in the right direction.
details: A brand-new user (zero follows) opens the Feed, taps the Following tab — which opens the Popular/Recent mode menu (heroui actionMenuPopup, now mirrored by the feed's e2e-heroui-menu-open probe) — and picks Popular: the Following feed must settle into its dedicated 'You're not following anyone yet' guidance card (EmptyFeed no-follows mode) instead of a blank list or spinner; drawer.navigation only proved the For You tab lands
